Pets are beloved members of the family, but they can sometimes leave behind stains and odors that are tough to remove. Whether it's urine, vomit, or other messes, pet stains can penetrate deep into carpets, upholstery, and other fabrics, leaving behind lingering odors. Over time, these stains can be difficult to remove with conventional cleaning methods. Professional pet stain and odor treatment is essential for restoring your home’s cleanliness and freshness, ensuring your living spaces are comfortable and odor-free. At Carpet & Duct Cleaning, we specialize in pet stain and odor removal services designed to target even the toughest messes. Our team uses specialized, pet-safe cleaning solutions that break down stains and eliminate odors at their source. Unlike standard cleaning methods, our approach focuses on the underlying cause of the odor, ensuring long-lasting results. We understand the sensitivity of pet owners, which is why we ensure that the products we use are safe for both pets and humans.

Pet urine is one of the most common causes of stubborn stains and odors. When urine is left untreated, it can soak deep into carpet fibers, padding, and even subflooring, causing permanent damage. Our pet urine treatment involves deep extraction methods and advanced enzymatic cleaners that break down urine molecules, neutralizing the odor and preventing future stains. This thorough process ensures that the smell is completely eliminated, rather than just masked, leaving your home fresh and clean. In addition to removing stains and odors, our pet stain treatment also helps prevent future accidents by treating the affected areas. We offer protection treatments that act as a barrier, making it harder for pets to return to the same spots. This helps maintain the cleanliness of your home while protecting your carpets and upholstery from further damage. Regular professional treatment can significantly extend the life of your furnishings, keeping them looking and smelling fresh for longer. At Carpet & Duct Cleaning, we understand that pet stains and odors can be a significant concern for pet owners, which is why we prioritize a comprehensive, effective cleaning process. Whether it's a small accident or a more extensive issue, our team is equipped to handle it with care and professionalism. With our pet stain and odor treatment services, we help you create a clean, comfortable home for both you and your pets.

With our pet stain and odor treatment services, we help you create a clean, comfortable home for both you and your pets. FAQs How can I remove pet urine stains from my carpet? For fresh pet urine stains, immediately blot the area with paper towels to absorb as much liquid as possible. Avoid rubbing, as this can spread the stain. After blotting, apply a solution of equal parts white vinegar and water to the stained area. Let it sit for 5–10 minutes, then blot again to absorb the solution. For older or set-in stains, consider using an enzymatic cleaner designed for pet stains, as these break down the proteins causing the odor . What can I use to neutralize pet odors in my home? Baking soda is an effective and natural deodorizer. Sprinkle it generously over carpets, rugs, or upholstery, let it sit for 15–30 minutes, then vacuum thoroughly. For a homemade spray, mix equal parts white vinegar and water in a spray bottle, lightly mist the area, and allow it to air dry. The vinegar smell will dissipate as it dries, leaving the area fresh . Are there any commercial products that work well for pet stains and odors? Nature’s Miracle : A widely trusted brand that uses enzymes to break down pet waste and odors. Humane World for Animals Angry Orange : Known for its powerful citrus scent and effectiveness in neutralizing strong odors . Amazon+1 Puracy Natural Pet Stain & Odor Remover : A plant-based formula that's safe for pets and effective on various surfaces . Can I use a steam cleaner to remove pet stains? It's generally not recommended to use a steam cleaner on pet stains. The heat can set the stain and odor deeper into the fibers, making it more difficult to remove. Instead, focus on blotting the area and using appropriate cleaning solutions as mentioned above . How can I prevent my pet from urinating in the same spot again? Use deterrents : Spray the area with a pet-safe deterrent or a mixture of water and vinegar. Limit access : Keep your pet away from the cleaned area until the scent has dissipated. Positive reinforcement : Reward your pet for using the designated bathroom area to encourage good habits .
